components.description: A miniature sword worth 250+ gp; retained

review.access: Normal 2024 Wizard spell-list access; learn and prepare through the Wizard's normal rules.
review.scope: Listed mechanics checked against the official current entry or SRD 5.2.1. Tier and acquisition advice are Compendium editorial judgments, not official rules.

compendium.summary: A legal Wizard spell with a high opportunity cost: seventh-level concentration and repeated Bonus Actions for a single attacking effect. Usually a low-priority acquisition.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: The revised spell's initial melee spell attack deals 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a hit. Later Bonus Actions move the sword up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.
Compare this with a spell that removes several enemy turns or solves a new strategic problem. 'Usually skip' is an optimization judgment, not a statement that the spell is unavailable.
The SRD uses the name Arcane Sword for this spell. Do not use the legacy damage profile when evaluating the 2024 version.
